purpose: Canonical Brain index of durable technical and operational learnings surfaced in the active Powerhouse/Bedrijfsgeheugen chat. Conversation text is evidence/context, never the durable source of truth.

learnings.symptom: Make scenario metadata can simultaneously report status=paused and isActive=true while recent executions or an immediate trigger show real runtime activity.
learnings.rootCause: Different Make fields represent different lifecycle, scheduling, trigger or callable states and are not a single authoritative activity truth.
learnings.failedApproach: Infer ownership, cutover, retirement or runtime activity from one status field.
learnings.fix: Combine scenario metadata, trigger/scheduling mode, recent executions, webhook/trigger state and readback before classifying activity.
learnings.regressionContract: Scenario adapters must never derive activity from a single Make status field.

learnings.symptom: A watcher repeatedly treats the same unchanged open blocker as a fresh error, producing duplicate notifications, analysis and paid recovery work.
learnings.rootCause: No persistent blocker fingerprint, aging, state hash or dedupe window exists before downstream dispatch.
learnings.failedApproach: Rely on downstream learning dedupe after the paid recovery dispatch already happened.
learnings.fix: Persist caller-side blocker state and coalesce unchanged blockers before paid dispatch while allowing changed state and bounded escalation.
learnings.regressionContract: Same record plus same blocker-state within the configured window dispatches downstream recovery at most once.

learnings.symptom: Instagram create returns an ID but the intended public post outcome is not independently verified.
learnings.rootCause: Provider create acknowledgement was treated as publication proof.
learnings.fix: Create -> GetMedia/provider readback -> verified native ID/permalink -> success commit; reconcile before any retry.
learnings.regressionContract: No published success write without exact provider readback evidence.

learnings.symptom: A Notion search can yield an empty/sentinel result and a downstream update then fails with an invalid request URL because no real page ID exists.
learnings.rootCause: Search completion was conflated with record existence.
learnings.failedApproach: Run a Notion update whenever search executed, without validating an actual page ID.
learnings.fix: Require a real Notion page ID before any update; no ID is a deterministic no-op or recovery obligation, never an update target.
learnings.regressionContract: Downstream Notion writes require id exists and never consume empty search sentinels.

learnings.symptom: Native Instagram media IDs can enter a legacy Buffer route, causing identity-domain mismatch and invalid analytics/publication behavior.
learnings.rootCause: Native and legacy scheduler identities were not kept in separate routing domains.
learnings.failedApproach: Send native Instagram records through Buffer legacy analytics/publishing paths.
learnings.fix: Keep native Instagram IDs and Buffer legacy IDs strictly separated and require explicit successor/compatibility mapping.
learnings.regressionContract: Native Instagram records never enter Buffer legacy routes.

learnings.symptom: Meta returns (#100) metric is required while the Make wrapper/scenario may still terminate as success through error handling.
learnings.rootCause: The GetMediaInsights metric serialization was not runtime-proven and scenario success masked module-level failure.
learnings.failedApproach: Guess metric strings or infer validity from terminal scenario success.
learnings.fix: Keep advanced insights fail-closed until exact mapper serialization and media-type metric sets produce a real non-error insight bundle.
learnings.regressionContract: Advanced insight route cannot be marked verified without non-error provider insight output for a proven native media ID.

learnings.symptom: Multiple Instagram/Facebook connections exist in the same production chain and can create split ownership or inconsistent authorization behavior.
learnings.rootCause: Connection standardization was treated as module-local configuration instead of production-chain ownership.
learnings.failedApproach: Leave multiple active credentials/connections across modules of one canonical publisher chain.
learnings.fix: Use one canonical Instagram Business connection per production chain and verify every module references it.
learnings.regressionContract: All Instagram modules in a production chain resolve to the canonical connection ID.

learnings.symptom: Temporary diagnostics can remain callable/active after evidence collection and create unexpected traffic or cost.
learnings.rootCause: Diagnostic lifecycle and cleanup were not part of the test harness contract.
learnings.failedApproach: Leave temporary probes enabled after evidence has been captured.
learnings.fix: Use bounded read-only diagnostics where possible and deactivate/retire temporary scenarios immediately after evidence readback.
learnings.regressionContract: No temporary diagnostic remains active after its evidence obligation is satisfied.

learnings.symptom: Identical native Instagram basic-metric snapshots can be written repeatedly, causing duplicate learning and unnecessary shared-context refresh.
learnings.rootCause: Snapshot dedupe occurred after write or was absent.
learnings.failedApproach: Write every polling snapshot regardless of post ID plus likes/comments equality.
learnings.fix: Dedupe before create/write; identical post ID + likes + comments produces no new record and no learning refresh.
learnings.regressionContract: Unchanged metric snapshot yields zero downstream Datahub/learning writes.

learnings.symptom: A legacy Buffer analytics path can be retired before current runtime evidence proves zero remaining legacy traffic and native successor coverage.
learnings.rootCause: Structural migration readiness was confused with operational cutover proof.
learnings.failedApproach: Deactivate legacy owner based on configuration intent or one ambiguous run.
learnings.fix: Retire only after a current full run proves zero legacy traffic and successor covers outcome and learning obligations.
learnings.regressionContract: Legacy route retirement requires exact current execution evidence plus successor parity.

learnings.symptom: A candidate becomes non-mergeable or unsafe because main changes while verification is running.
learnings.rootCause: Candidate identity and overlap were evaluated against a stale base while concurrent work advanced main.
learnings.failedApproach: Blindly merge or rebuild everything whenever main moves.
learnings.fix: Re-read main before delivery, compare file plus semantic/contract overlap, sync only overlapping candidates and preserve exact candidate evidence for independent drift.
learnings.regressionContract: Moving-main check distinguishes independent drift from overlapping contract changes before promotion.

learnings.symptom: A transient/stale PR mergeability read during moving-main causes an unnecessary replacement PR even though the original PR was already mergeable or merged.
learnings.rootCause: A mutable PR status snapshot was treated as authoritative without immediate original-PR and current-main readback.
learnings.failedApproach: Create a replacement candidate solely because one mergeable=false snapshot was observed.
learnings.fix: Before reconstruction, re-read the original PR and current main; if original is merged or equivalent content is already on main, do not reconstruct and close duplicates.
learnings.regressionContract: Replacement creation is blocked unless fresh original-PR and main readback prove the candidate is still needed.

learnings.symptom: Internal CI is green while GitHub main remains protected=false with zero repository rulesets.
learnings.rootCause: Post-push detection and internal governance cannot substitute for native pre-ref-mutation branch/ruleset enforcement.
learnings.failedApproach: Treat green CI as proof that direct-main mutation is structurally impossible.
learnings.fix: Fail closed until native branch protection/ruleset is directly observed; retain exact-head PR governance and do not simulate protection with post-push CI.
learnings.regressionContract: Main protection readiness requires positive native protection, matching current main SHA, ruleset evidence and required checks.

learnings.symptom: An agent reports done/green while material outcome, delivery, recovery or production obligations remain open.
learnings.rootCause: Local technical green was conflated with end-to-end completion.
learnings.failedApproach: Stop after a locally successful substep.
learnings.fix: Continue until all material obligations are terminal/green or an explicit current hard boundary is proven.

learnings.symptom: AgentWork can reach a local terminal status while a global production/delivery/recovery/outcome obligation remains OPEN.
learnings.rootCause: Terminal work-item transitions did not consistently use the shared completion-readiness policy.
learnings.failedApproach: Treat local Verifying -> Resolved as sufficient end-to-end proof.
learnings.fix: Every non-terminal -> terminal AgentWork transition must fail closed through the central completion readiness evaluator.

learnings.symptom: A regression test exists in the repository but the mandatory CI command does not execute it, creating false confidence.
learnings.rootCause: Test creation and gate registration evolved independently.
learnings.failedApproach: Count a test file as protection without proving that a required gate runs it.
learnings.fix: Register every material regression in a mandatory CI/gate and add a meta-regression that verifies the registration remains present.
learnings.regressionContract: tests/brain-chat-learning-completeness.test.mjs must remain in Shared Agent Memory Tests.

learnings.symptom: A PR can be green but integrated main turns red because a regression test pins an exact minor contract version while compatible concurrent learning advances that minor version.
learnings.rootCause: The test encoded incidental version text rather than stable major-family and semantic invariants.
learnings.failedApproach: Assert an exact compatible minor version as if it were a breaking contract boundary.
learnings.fix: Keep major family, fingerprints and safety invariants strict while allowing compatible minor evolution; require post-merge main CI as a separate integration gate.
learnings.regressionContract: Post-merge Shared Agent Memory must pass on exact main SHA.
